space.label: Skills
space.answers: What reusable capability is needed, how does it operate, and how can quality be recognized?
space.write: Check for an existing skill first; create or change one only when the capability is reusable and the request authorizes it.
do_not: Do not create a skill when a relationship, workflow, recipe, or persona application is sufficient.

routes.request: Identify, define, deduplicate, or maintain capabilities behind a Persona
non_triggers: Applying an existing capability to a one-off project without changing the library
routes.next_handoff: Use the Persona-specific adapter, then the universal impact pass when required.

routes.request: Form a reusable capability from distinct Persona perspectives
first_reads: related Templates when the capability supplies a starting artifact
non_triggers: A request to merely use an existing Skill
routes.next_handoff: Hand the bounded build brief to pl-skill-creator only when a standalone package is justified.

routes.request: Create or update a reusable callable Skill package
non_triggers: One-off issue, document, workflow, or Persona application work
A documented mention without an approved reusable capability
routes.next_handoff: Run package validation and reconcile affected catalog, docs, and generated surfaces.

routes.request: Run each selected Persona Skill in a fresh isolated low-reasoning task and evaluate the response
non_triggers: Testing without a defined Skill profile or expected quality signal
Claiming independent conformance when the observer shares the runner runtime
routes.next_handoff: Archive temporary tasks, store sanitized results under eval/results/isolated/, and run one bounded impact review.

routes.request: Inspect or summarize a local video file from representative frames and available transcript evidence
first_reads: available local decoder and image-inspection capability
sidecar or embedded transcript evidence when available
non_triggers: Installing or downloading codecs, transcription models, or dependencies without separate authorization
routes.next_handoff: Keep extracted evidence temporary unless the request authorizes a durable artifact; reconcile only when execution creates durable repository state.

routes.request: Map a private candidate Resume Content Model into a verified resume Template while preserving the designated baseline and material meaning
first_reads: standing-decision-designated Candidate Baseline Resume when one is active
non_triggers: Discovering candidate evidence or deciding whether a claim is true
Designing a new reusable Template from scratch
Replacing ATS, accessibility, document-production, or export validation
routes.next_handoff: Return the bounded semantic mapping to the application workflow, then run the applicable artifact and cross-space validation when durable output is created.
